content: If NmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and a retransmission timer for a PN shutdown message (see NmP- nShutdownMessageRetransmissionDuration ) expires, then Nm shall remove the pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdown of the cor- responding NM-channel from the storage and report the runtime error NM_E_TRANSMISSION_OF_PN_SHUTDOWN_MESSAGE_FAILED to DET .
